aulas.objetivo: Entender horários em conversas curtas: horas cheias, meias horas e quinze minutos.
aulas.foco: Telling the time: o'clock, half past, quarter past/to, twenty past
explicacao: Hora cheia: It's eight o'clock. Meia hora: half past eight (8h30).
Quinze minutos depois: quarter past eight (8h15). Quinze minutos antes: quarter to nine (8h45).
Outros minutos: ten past eight, twenty past eight, twenty to nine.
Atenção: no áudio, 'quarter to eight' é 7h45, não 8h15. E 'half past seven' é 7h30, não 6h30.

falas.t: Mum, what time is it?
It's a quarter to eight, Tom. Your bus leaves at eight o'clock.
Oh no! I thought it was half past seven.
No, half past seven was fifteen minutes ago. Hurry up!
What time does the first lesson start?
At twenty past eight. Maths with Mr Brown. And lunch is at half past twelve.
And football practice?
At four o'clock, but I'll collect you at a quarter past five.
OK, Mum. Can I have my sandwich now?
It's in your bag. Now run!

exercicios.q: What time does Tom's bus leave?
exercicios.exp: A mãe diz: Your bus leaves at eight o'clock. Quarter to eight (7h45) é a hora atual e twenty past eight é a hora da aula.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: The first lesson starts at ___ past eight.
exercicios.exp: A aula começa às 8h20: twenty past eight.
exercicios.ouvir: The first lesson starts at twenty past eight.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Lunch is at half past twelve.
exercicios.exp: Half past: /haf pást/. Twelve termina com o som /v/, com os dentes no lábio.
exercicios.ouvir: Lunch is at half past twelve.

exercicios.q: What time will Tom's mum collect him?
exercicios.exp: O treino é às quatro, mas ela vai buscá-lo às 5h15: a quarter past five.

exercicios.resp: What time does the first lesson start?
exercicios.exp: Pergunta com what time + does + sujeito + verbo sem -s: start.

exercicios.q: Segundo o diálogo: Lunch is at half past ___.
exercicios.exp: Lunch is at half past twelve: meio-dia e meia.

exercicios.q: Responda dizendo a que horas você acorda.
exercicios.frase: What time do you get up?
exercicios.modelo: I get up at half past six.
exercicios.exp: Use: I get up at + hora. Ex.: at seven o'clock, at a quarter past six.

exercicios.q: How long ago was it half past seven?
exercicios.exp: São 7h45; 7h30 foi há 15 minutos (fifteen). Cuidado: twenty e half também aparecem no áudio, mas com outros sentidos.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: I'll collect you at a ___ past five.
exercicios.exp: A quarter past five = 5h15. Quarter significa um quarto de hora.
exercicios.ouvir: Football practice is at four o'clock, but I'll collect you at a quarter past five.

aulas.objetivo: Entender preços em libras e pence, troco e formas de pagamento.
aulas.foco: Prices (£ and p); numbers 13-19 vs 30-90; change; cash and card
explicacao: Preços: £3.50 lê-se three pounds fifty. 80p lê-se eighty pence.
Cuidado com os números: thirteen (13) e thirty (30) soam parecidos. Em thirTEEN a força está no final; em THIRty, no começo.
Perguntas úteis: How much is it? How much are they? Can I pay by card? Here's your change.
Cash = dinheiro em espécie; change = troco; note = cédula; coin = moeda.

falas.t: Good morning. Can I help you?
Yes, how much is this notebook?
The blue one is three pounds fifty and the red one is five pounds thirty.
Hmm, and the pens?
They're eighty pence each, or two pounds for three.
I'll take the blue notebook and three pens, please.
That's five pounds fifty altogether.
Can I pay by card?
Sorry, cash only today.
No problem. Here's a ten-pound note.
Thank you. Here's your change, four pounds fifty.
Have a nice day!
You too. Goodbye.

exercicios.q: How much is the blue notebook?
exercicios.exp: The blue one is three pounds fifty. £5.30 é o caderno vermelho e £5.50 é o total da compra.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: The pens are ___ pence each.
exercicios.exp: Eighty pence (80p) cada caneta. Não confunda com eighteen (18).
exercicios.ouvir: The pens are eighty pence each.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: How much is this notebook?
exercicios.exp: How much: /hau mátch/. Notebook: a força está em NOTE.
exercicios.ouvir: How much is this notebook?

exercicios.q: What does the customer buy?
op: A blue notebook and three pens
A red notebook and three pens
A blue notebook and one pen
A red notebook and a pen
exercicios.exp: I'll take the blue notebook and three pens. O caderno vermelho é só mencionado.
Can I + verbo = pedir permissão. Pay by card = pagar no cartão.

exercicios.q: Segundo o diálogo, o total é £___.
exercicios.exp: Notebook 3.50 + três canetas 2.00 = 5.50 (five pounds fifty).

exercicios.q: Diga quanto custa um café na sua cidade.
exercicios.frase: How much is a cup of coffee in your town?
exercicios.modelo: A cup of coffee is about five reais.
exercicios.exp: Use: It is about... ou It costs... Ex.: It costs six reais.

exercicios.q: How much change does the customer get?
exercicios.exp: Ele paga com £10 e a compra é £5.50, então o troco é four pounds fifty.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: Here's your change, four pounds ___.
exercicios.exp: Four pounds fifty = £4.50. Ouça a diferença entre fifty (50) e fifteen (15).
exercicios.ouvir: Thank you. Here's your change, four pounds fifty.

aulas.objetivo: Entender dias da semana, datas e meses em combinados entre amigos.
aulas.foco: Days; months; ordinal numbers (the thirteenth); on + date
explicacao: Datas usam números ordinais: first, second, third, fourth... twelfth, thirteenth, fifteenth, twentieth.
Dizemos the thirteenth of May (13 de maio). Escrevemos 13th May ou May 13th.
Usamos on com dias e datas: on Friday, on the fifteenth. Usamos in com meses: in May.
Atenção: fifteenth (15º) e fiftieth (50º) são diferentes; thirteenth (13º) e thirtieth (30º) também.

falas.t: Emma, when is your birthday?
It's on the thirteenth of May. But the party is on Saturday, the fifteenth.
Oh no, I'm in Bath on the fifteenth. I come back on Sunday.
What a pity! Could you come on Friday the fourteenth? We're having a small dinner then.
Yes! What about your dad? Does he work on Fridays?
Until six, but don't worry, dinner is at seven.
Perfect. The twelfth is my brother's birthday, so I'll be busy that day too.

exercicios.q: When is Emma's birthday?
exercicios.exp: It's on the thirteenth of May. 15 é a data da festa, 14 é o jantar e 12 é o aniversário do irmão da amiga.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: The party is on Saturday, the ___.
exercicios.exp: The fifteenth = dia 15. Ouça bem a diferença entre fifteenth e fiftieth.
exercicios.ouvir: The party is on Saturday, the fifteenth.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: My birthday is on the thirteenth of May.
exercicios.exp: Thirteenth: o 'th' é com a língua entre os dentes. The thirteenth of = /dhe thertínth ov/.
exercicios.ouvir: My birthday is on the thirteenth of May.

exercicios.q: Why can't Emma's friend go to the party?
op: She is busy with her brother's birthday
exercicios.exp: I'm in Bath on the fifteenth: a amiga está viajando no dia da festa. O aniversário do irmão é no dia 12.

exercicios.resp: Dinner is on Friday the fourteenth.
exercicios.exp: Estrutura: Dinner is on + dia da semana + the + ordinal.

exercicios.q: Her brother's birthday is on the ___.
exercicios.exp: The twelfth is my brother's birthday. Twelfth = 12º.

exercicios.q: Diga a data do seu aniversário.
exercicios.frase: When is your birthday?
exercicios.modelo: My birthday is on the tenth of June.
exercicios.exp: Use: My birthday is on the ... of ... Ex.: the third of April.

exercicios.q: What time is dinner on Friday?
exercicios.exp: Dad works until six, but dinner is at seven. Six é o horário em que o pai sai do trabalho.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: We're having a small ___ then.
exercicios.exp: Em vez de uma festa, eles terão um pequeno jantar (dinner) na sexta.
exercicios.ouvir: Could you come on Friday the fourteenth? We're having a small dinner then.

aulas.objetivo: Entender nomes soletrados, números de telefone e idades para preencher formulários.
aulas.foco: The alphabet; double letters/numbers; phone numbers; ages
explicacao: Em formulários, o nome é soletrado letra por letra: Kerry = K-E-R-R-Y.
Letras que confundem: A (/êi/) e E (/i/), G (/dji/) e J (/djêi/), I (/ai/) e Y (/uai/).
Números de telefone: dizemos um dígito de cada vez. 0 = oh, e 88 = double eight.
Idades: seventeen (17) e seventy (70) soam parecidas. Em seven-TEEN a força está no fim.

falas.t: Library. How can I help?
I'd like to join, please.
Of course. What's your surname?
It's Whitlow. That's W-H-I-T-L-O-W.
And your first name?
Kerry, with a K. K-E-R-R-Y.
Thanks. And your mobile number?
Oh seven seven oh nine, three one four, five double eight.
And how old are you?
Seventeen.
Seventeen or seventy?
Ha! Seventeen.
Great. Now I need your address.
Flat twelve, Rose Court, Leeds.
Thank you, Kerry. Your card will be ready on Monday.
Do I need to bring anything?
Just a photo of yourself.

exercicios.q: What is the customer's surname?
exercicios.exp: O sobrenome é soletrado: W-H-I-T-L-O-W = Whitlow.

exercicios.q: Ouça as letras e escreva o sobrenome: ___
exercicios.exp: W-H-I-T-L-O-W forma Whitlow.
exercicios.ouvir: W. H. I. T. L. O. W.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: My first name is Kerry, with a K.
exercicios.exp: With a K: /uíd a kêi/. A letra K em inglês se diz /kêi/.
exercicios.ouvir: My first name is Kerry, with a K.

exercicios.q: What is Kerry's mobile number?
exercicios.exp: Oh seven seven oh nine, three one four, five double eight = 07709 314 588.

exercicios.resp: How do you spell your surname?
exercicios.exp: Pergunta para pedir soletração: How do you spell...?

exercicios.q: Kerry is ___ years old.
exercicios.exp: Ela confirma: Seventeen. A funcionária pergunta se é 17 ou 70 para ter certeza.

exercicios.q: Diga seu primeiro nome e soletre.
exercicios.frase: What's your first name? Can you spell it?
exercicios.modelo: My name is Ana. A, N, A.
exercicios.exp: Diga My name is... e depois as letras. Treine o alfabeto: A /êi/, E /i/, I /ai/.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is TRUE?
op: Kerry's name starts with a C.
Kerry's number has a double eight.
exercicios.exp: Five double eight: o 88 no final. Ela tem 17 anos, o nome começa com K e o sobrenome é Whitlow.

exercicios.q: Ouça e escreva os números: 07709 314 ___
exercicios.exp: Five double eight = 588.
exercicios.ouvir: Oh seven seven oh nine, three one four, five double eight.

aulas.titulo: Where is it? Addresses and directions
aulas.objetivo: Entender indicações de caminho, endereços e a posição de lugares.
aulas.foco: Directions (turn left, go straight on); prepositions of place; addresses
explicacao: Direções: go straight on (siga em frente), turn left/right (vire à esquerda/direita), at the traffic lights (no semáforo).
Lugares: opposite (em frente a), next to (ao lado de), between (entre), behind (atrás de), near (perto).
Endereço: forty-two Park Road = 42 Park Road. Cuidado: forty (40) e fourteen (14) são diferentes.
On foot = a pé. It's five minutes on foot = fica a cinco minutos a pé.

falas.t: Excuse me, how do I get to the Science Museum?
Go straight on until the traffic lights, then turn left into Park Road.
Is it far?
No, it's about five minutes on foot. It's opposite the bank, next to the cinema.
Thank you. And what's the address? I need to write it on a form.
It's forty-two Park Road.
Forty-two or fourteen?
Forty-two.
Is there a café near here?
Yes, the Blue Cup is between the museum and the library.

exercicios.q: Where does the woman turn left?
exercicios.exp: Go straight on until the traffic lights, then turn left. O banco e o cinema ajudam a localizar o museu.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: Go ___ on until the traffic lights.
exercicios.exp: Go straight on = siga em frente.
exercicios.ouvir: Go straight on until the traffic lights.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: How do I get to the Science Museum?
exercicios.exp: Science: /sáiens/. Museum: a força está em MU-ZI-um, com som de /ziú/.
exercicios.ouvir: How do I get to the Science Museum?

exercicios.q: Where exactly is the museum?
op: Between the bank and the library
exercicios.exp: It's opposite the bank, next to the cinema. O café fica entre o museu e a biblioteca.

exercicios.resp: It's about five minutes on foot.
exercicios.exp: On foot = a pé. Compare: by bus (de ônibus), by car (de carro).

exercicios.q: The museum is at ___ Park Road.
exercicios.exp: O endereço é forty-two Park Road. A pessoa confirma: forty-two, não fourteen.

exercicios.q: Diga onde fica sua escola ou o seu trabalho.
exercicios.frase: Where is your school?
exercicios.modelo: My school is next to a park and opposite a bank.
exercicios.exp: Use opposite, next to, near ou between. Ex.: It's near my house.

exercicios.q: Where is the Blue Cup café?
op: Between the museum and the library
exercicios.exp: The Blue Cup is between the museum and the library. As outras posições são do museu.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: It's opposite the ___, next to the cinema.
exercicios.exp: Opposite the bank = em frente ao banco.
exercicios.ouvir: It's opposite the bank, next to the cinema.

aulas.titulo: My day: routines and free time
aulas.objetivo: Entender rotinas diárias e com que frequência as pessoas fazem cada coisa.
aulas.foco: Present simple; adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, never)
explicacao: Present simple para rotinas: I get up at six. He starts work at four. Com he/she/it o verbo ganha -s.
Frequência, do mais ao menos: always (sempre), usually (geralmente), often (muitas vezes), sometimes (às vezes), never (nunca).
O advérbio vem antes do verbo principal: I always start at four. He never watches TV.
Atenção ao áudio: a pessoa pode dizer 'usually, yes, but sometimes...'. Escute as duas partes antes de marcar.

falas.t: Jack, you're a baker. What's your day like?
I get up at three in the morning! I always start work at four.
Wow. Do you have breakfast at work?
Usually, yes, but sometimes I have it at home. I finish at noon, then I go home and sleep for two hours.
And in the evening?
I never watch TV. I often play the guitar, and on Sundays I always visit my grandmother.
What a busy day! Thanks for talking to us, Jack.
My pleasure.

exercicios.q: What time does Jack start work?
exercicios.exp: I always start work at four. Ele acorda às três (get up), mas começa a trabalhar às quatro.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: I ___ start work at four.
exercicios.exp: Always = sempre. O advérbio vem antes do verbo start.
exercicios.ouvir: I always start work at four.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I often play the guitar in the evening.
exercicios.exp: Often pode ser /ófen/ ou /óften/. Guitar: força no meio, gi-TAR.
exercicios.ouvir: I often play the guitar in the evening.

exercicios.q: What does Jack do after work?
exercicios.exp: Depois do trabalho: I go home and sleep for two hours. O violão é à noite e a avó é aos domingos.

exercicios.resp: He never watches TV in the evening.
exercicios.exp: Never fica antes do verbo. Com he, o verbo leva -s: watches.

exercicios.q: Jack ___ watches TV.
exercicios.exp: I never watch TV: ele nunca assiste TV.

exercicios.q: Diga o que você faz aos domingos, usando um advérbio de frequência.
exercicios.frase: What do you do on Sundays?
exercicios.modelo: I usually visit my family and sometimes I watch a film.
exercicios.exp: Coloque o advérbio antes do verbo: I often go to the park.

exercicios.q: Where does Jack usually have breakfast?
exercicios.exp: Usually, yes, but sometimes I have it at home: normalmente no trabalho; só às vezes em casa.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: ___, yes, but sometimes I have it at home.
exercicios.exp: Usually = geralmente. Sometimes = às vezes: o contraste ajuda a entender a rotina.
exercicios.ouvir: Usually, yes, but sometimes I have it at home.

aulas.objetivo: Entender conversas em lojas de roupa: cores, tamanhos, preços e como pagar.
aulas.foco: Clothes; colours; sizes; too + adjective; try on
explicacao: Tamanhos: small (P), medium (M), large (G). Perguntas úteis: What size are you? Do you have it in medium?
Can I try it on? = Posso experimentar? The changing rooms = os provadores.
Too + adjetivo = demais: It's too big. It's too expensive. It fits = serve bem.
Cores aparecem junto ao preço e ao tamanho: preste atenção em qual combinação a loja realmente tem.

falas.t: Can I help you?
Yes, I'm looking for a warm jacket. I like green.
This green one is thirty-five pounds, but we only have it in small. What size are you?
Medium, I think.
Then try this blue one. It comes in medium. It's forty pounds.
Can I try it on?
Of course. The changing rooms are at the back.
It's lovely, and it fits! I haven't got any cash, so I'll pay by card.
Wonderful. Come to the till, please.

exercicios.q: What colour jacket does Lucy want at first?
exercicios.exp: I'm looking for a warm jacket. I like green. A jaqueta azul é a sugestão da vendedora.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: I'm looking for a warm ___.
exercicios.exp: Jacket = jaqueta. I'm looking for = estou procurando.
exercicios.ouvir: I'm looking for a warm jacket.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Can I try it on?
exercicios.exp: Try it on: ligue as palavras, /trái it on/. Subida de entonação no final, por ser pergunta.
exercicios.ouvir: Can I try it on?

exercicios.q: Why doesn't Lucy buy the green jacket?
op: They only have it in small
exercicios.exp: We only have it in small, mas Lucy usa medium. O preço (£35) é menor que o da azul.

exercicios.resp: This blue one comes in medium.
exercicios.exp: Comes in = existe em (tamanho ou cor). Ex.: It comes in red.

exercicios.q: The blue jacket costs ___ pounds.
exercicios.exp: O preço da azul é forty pounds. Thirty-five é o da verde.

exercicios.q: Descreva a roupa que você está usando hoje.
exercicios.frase: What are you wearing today?
exercicios.modelo: I'm wearing a white T-shirt and blue jeans.
exercicios.exp: Use I'm wearing + roupa. Ex.: I'm wearing a black jacket and brown shoes.

exercicios.q: How will Lucy pay?
exercicios.exp: I haven't got any cash, so I'll pay by card. Cash é o que ela NÃO tem.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: I haven't got any ___, so I'll pay by card.
exercicios.exp: Cash = dinheiro vivo. Ela não tem, então paga com cartão.
exercicios.ouvir: I haven't got any cash, so I'll pay by card.

aulas.objetivo: Entender horários de trem, plataformas, preços de passagens e duração de viagens.
aulas.foco: Transport; single/return; platform; how long; prices
explicacao: Single ticket = só ida. Return ticket = ida e volta. Platform = plataforma.
How long does it take? It takes about an hour. A viagem dura mais ou menos uma hora.
Horários de trem são ditos assim: ten forty = 10h40; ten fifteen = 10h15. Ouça se o trem já saiu (has just left).
Preço total: dois bilhetes de £12.40 custam £24.80. Faça a conta enquanto ouve.

falas.t: Next, please.
Two return tickets to Oxford, please.
Oh, the ten fifteen has just left. The next train is at ten forty, from platform three.
How long does it take?
About an hour. It's twelve pounds forty each, so twenty-four pounds eighty.
Fine. Is it the same price for the journey back?
Yes, the return ticket is for any train on the same day.
Thanks. Platform three, you said?
Hurry, then. The train is already at the platform.
Thank you so much.

exercicios.q: Which platform is the train to Oxford?
exercicios.exp: The next train is at ten forty, from platform three.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: The next train leaves at ten ___.
exercicios.exp: Ten forty = 10h40. Atenção a forty (40) e fourteen (14).
exercicios.ouvir: The next train is at ten forty.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Two return tickets to Oxford, please.
exercicios.exp: Return: força em -TURN. Tickets: /tíkits/. Oxford: /óks-fêrd/.
exercicios.ouvir: Two return tickets to Oxford, please.

exercicios.q: What time does the next train leave?
exercicios.exp: O das 10h15 acabou de sair (has just left). O próximo é às 10h40.

exercicios.resp: How long does the journey take?
exercicios.exp: How long does ... take? pergunta a duração. Resposta: It takes about an hour.

exercicios.q: The journey takes about an ___.
exercicios.exp: About an hour: cerca de uma hora. Hour começa com h mudo, por isso an hour.

exercicios.q: Diga como você vai ao trabalho ou à escola e quanto tempo leva.
exercicios.frase: How do you usually get to school or work?
exercicios.modelo: I usually go by bus. It takes twenty minutes.
exercicios.exp: Use by + transporte (by bus) ou on foot. E diga It takes + tempo.

exercicios.q: How much do the two tickets cost altogether?
exercicios.exp: Cada passagem custa £12.40; duas custam £24.80 (twenty-four pounds eighty).

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: It's twelve pounds forty each, so ___ pounds eighty.
exercicios.exp: Twelve forty × 2 = twenty-four eighty.
exercicios.ouvir: It's twelve pounds forty each, so twenty-four pounds eighty.

aulas.objetivo: Entender pedidos em restaurantes, o que está acabado e o que cada pessoa escolhe.
aulas.foco: Food and drink; I'd like / I'll have; countable and uncountable; allergies
explicacao: Para pedir: I'd like a sandwich. / I'll have the soup. / Can I have a lemonade, please?
O garçom pode dizer o que NÃO tem: Sorry, we've no chicken today. Depois ele oferece outras opções (We have fish or pasta).
A pessoa muda de ideia com frequência: Chicken? No, pasta, please. Ouça a escolha final.
Alergia: I'm allergic to nuts. No onions, please = sem cebola, por favor.

falas.t: Are you ready to order?
Yes. I'll have the vegetable soup, please, and then the chicken with rice.
Sorry, we've no chicken today. We have fish or pasta.
Then pasta, please.
I'd like a cheese sandwich. And can I have an orange juice?
Orange juice is finished, but we have apple or lemonade.
Lemonade, then. Ben, what do you want to drink?
Just water, thanks. Oh, and no onions in the soup, please! I'm allergic.
Of course. I'll tell the kitchen. Your food will be here soon.

exercicios.q: What does Ben order for his main course?
exercicios.exp: Ele pede chicken, mas não há; então diz Then pasta, please. A sopa é a entrada.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: We have ___ or pasta.
exercicios.exp: O garçom oferece fish or pasta no lugar do frango.
exercicios.ouvir: Sorry, we've no chicken today. We have fish or pasta.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.
exercicios.exp: I'd like: /aid láik/. Sandwich: /sên-uitch/ ou /sân-uitch/.
exercicios.ouvir: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.

exercicios.q: What does Lily drink?
exercicios.exp: Lily quer orange juice, mas acabou; ela escolhe lemonade. Água é a bebida do Ben.

exercicios.resp: No onions in the soup, please.
exercicios.exp: No + substantivo no plural = sem. Please no final deixa o pedido educado.

exercicios.q: Ben can't eat ___ because he is allergic.
exercicios.exp: Ele diz: no onions in the soup! I'm allergic.

exercicios.q: Faça o seu pedido como em um restaurante.
exercicios.frase: What would you like to eat and drink?
exercicios.modelo: I'd like a pizza and a glass of orange juice.
exercicios.exp: Use I'd like... ou I'll have... e termine com please.

exercicios.q: Which sentence is TRUE?
op: Lily has a cheese sandwich and lemonade.
exercicios.exp: Lily: cheese sandwich + lemonade. O frango acabou, há macarrão e Lily não quis o suco de maçã.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: Orange juice is ___, but we have apple or lemonade.
exercicios.exp: Finished aqui significa acabou, não temos mais.
exercicios.ouvir: Orange juice is finished, but we have apple or lemonade.

aulas.objetivo: Entender planos para o fim de semana e previsões do tempo.
aulas.foco: be going to for plans and predictions; weather words; weekend activities
explicacao: Be going to + verbo mostra plano: I'm going to play tennis. They're going to arrive at six.
Também serve para previsão: It's going to rain. It's going to be sunny.
Tempo: sunny (ensolarado), rainy (chuvoso), windy (ventoso), cloudy (nublado), snowy (com neve).
Cuidado: os dias mudam. Sábado pode ter sol e domingo chuva. Anote cada dia.

falas.t: What are you going to do this weekend, Sam?
On Saturday I'm going to play tennis with my cousin, if it doesn't rain.
The forecast says it's going to be sunny on Saturday but rainy on Sunday, and windy on Monday.
Then on Sunday I'm going to stay at home and cook dinner for my parents. They're going to arrive at six.
Nice! I'm going to the cinema on Sunday afternoon. Do you want to come?
No, thanks. I'm going to be too busy with the cooking.

exercicios.q: What is Sam going to do on Saturday?
exercicios.exp: On Saturday I'm going to play tennis. Cozinhar e ficar em casa são planos de domingo.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: It's going to be ___ on Saturday.
exercicios.exp: Sábado: sunny. Domingo: rainy. Segunda: windy.
exercicios.ouvir: It's going to be sunny on Saturday.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: I'm going to play tennis with my cousin.
exercicios.exp: Going to costuma soar como /gônã/ no inglês falado. Cousin: /cázn/.
exercicios.ouvir: I'm going to play tennis with my cousin.

exercicios.q: What will the weather be like on Sunday?
exercicios.exp: Sunny on Saturday but rainy on Sunday. Windy é segunda-feira.

exercicios.resp: They are going to arrive at six.
exercicios.exp: Estrutura: sujeito + be + going to + verbo base (arrive).

exercicios.q: Sam's parents are going to ___ at six.
exercicios.exp: They're going to arrive at six: os pais chegam às seis.

exercicios.q: Conte um plano seu para o fim de semana usando going to.
exercicios.frase: What are you going to do this weekend?
exercicios.modelo: I'm going to visit my grandmother and watch a film.
exercicios.exp: Use I'm going to + verbo. Ex.: I'm going to go to the beach.

exercicios.q: Why doesn't Sam go to the cinema?
op: He is going to be busy cooking
exercicios.exp: I'm going to be too busy with the cooking. A chuva só é mencionada para o domingo, mas não é a razão.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: I'm going to stay at home and ___ dinner for my parents.
exercicios.exp: Cook dinner = preparar o jantar.
exercicios.ouvir: Then on Sunday I'm going to stay at home and cook dinner for my parents.

aulas.titulo: What did you do? Talking about the past
aulas.objetivo: Entender relatos sobre o que as pessoas fizeram em uma viagem ou no fim de semana.
aulas.foco: Past simple: regular (-ed) and irregular verbs (went, ate, flew, lost)
explicacao: Verbos regulares terminam em -ed: visited, stayed, watched, played.
Irregulares precisam ser decorados: go-went, eat-ate, fly-flew, lose-lost, buy-bought, see-saw.
Expressões de tempo: yesterday, last weekend, on Saturday, two days ago.
No áudio, preste atenção na sequência: first, then, on Sunday, in the evening.

falas.t: How was your holiday in Spain, Anna?
Great! We flew to Valencia on Friday and stayed in a small hotel near the centre. On Saturday we visited the old town. On Sunday we went to the beach, but I lost my sunglasses.
Oh no! Did you buy new ones?
Yes, they cost fifteen euros. And we ate paella in a lovely restaurant.
It sounds lovely. Did the weather stay nice?
Yes, it was hot and sunny every day. I'd like to go back next year.

exercicios.q: How did Anna travel to Valencia?
exercicios.exp: We flew to Valencia: flew é o passado de fly, ou seja, foram de avião.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: We ___ in a small hotel near the centre.
exercicios.exp: Stay é regular: stayed.
exercicios.ouvir: We flew to Valencia on Friday and stayed in a small hotel near the centre.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: On Sunday we went to the beach.
exercicios.exp: Went é o passado de go: /uént/. Beach: som longo /bi:tch/, não 'bitch'.
exercicios.ouvir: On Sunday we went to the beach.

exercicios.q: What did Anna do on Saturday?
exercicios.exp: On Saturday we visited the old town. A praia foi no domingo e o voo na sexta.

exercicios.resp: We visited the old town on Saturday.
exercicios.exp: Past simple afirmativo: sujeito + verbo no passado, sem auxiliar.

exercicios.q: They ___ paella in a lovely restaurant.
exercicios.exp: Eat é irregular: eat - ate - eaten.

exercicios.q: Conte uma coisa que você fez no último fim de semana.
exercicios.frase: What did you do last weekend?
exercicios.modelo: I visited my friends and we watched a film.
exercicios.exp: Use verbos no passado: I went to..., I watched..., I played...

exercicios.q: What did Anna lose on the beach?
exercicios.exp: On Sunday we went to the beach, but I lost my sunglasses. Depois ela comprou outros por quinze euros.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: On Sunday we ___ to the beach, but I lost my sunglasses.
exercicios.exp: Went é o passado irregular de go.
exercicios.ouvir: On Sunday we went to the beach, but I lost my sunglasses.

aulas.objetivo: Entender comparações de preço, tamanho e qualidade para chegar a uma escolha.
aulas.foco: Comparatives (cheaper, more expensive, better) and superlatives (the cheapest, the most comfortable)
explicacao: Adjetivos curtos: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; light - lighter - the lightest. Depois: than (do que).
Adjetivos longos: expensive - more expensive - the most expensive; comfortable - more comfortable - the most comfortable.
Irregulares: good - better - the best; bad - worse - the worst.
Em escolhas de compra, a pessoa compara várias coisas e depois decide pelo dinheiro que tem. Ouça o final.

falas.t: We have three bikes. The red one is the cheapest, at one hundred and twenty pounds, but it's heavy.
And the black one?
It's lighter and faster, but more expensive. One hundred and eighty pounds. The white one is the most expensive, two hundred and fifty, but it's the most comfortable.
Which is best for a long journey?
The white one. But the black is better for a short ride in town.
I only have two hundred pounds.
Then the black one is your best choice.

exercicios.q: Which bike is the cheapest?
exercicios.exp: The red one is the cheapest, at £120. A preta custa £180 e a branca £250.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: The red one is the ___.
exercicios.exp: Cheap + superlativo: the cheapest.
exercicios.ouvir: The red one is the cheapest, at one hundred and twenty pounds, but it's heavy.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: The white one is the most comfortable.
exercicios.exp: Most comfortable: /móust cãmftãbl/. Comfortable tem três sílabas: CÃMF-tã-bl.
exercicios.ouvir: The white one is the most comfortable.

exercicios.q: Why can't the customer buy the white bike?
op: It costs more than he has
exercicios.exp: The white one custa £250 e ele só tem £200 (I only have two hundred pounds).

exercicios.resp: The black bike is lighter than the red one.
exercicios.exp: Comparativo curto: adjetivo + -er + than.

exercicios.q: The black bike costs ___ pounds.
exercicios.exp: One hundred and eighty pounds = £180.

exercicios.q: Compare dois transportes e diga o que acha.
exercicios.frase: Which is better, the bus or the train? Why?
exercicios.modelo: I think the train is faster, but the bus is cheaper.
exercicios.exp: Use adjetivo + -er than, ou more + adjetivo longo. Ex.: The train is more comfortable than the bus.

exercicios.q: Which bike will the customer probably buy?
exercicios.exp: Then the black one is your best choice: cabe no orçamento de £200 e é leve e rápida.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: The black one is lighter and faster, but ___ expensive.
exercicios.exp: Expensive é longo, então: more expensive.
exercicios.ouvir: The black one is lighter and faster, but more expensive.

aulas.objetivo: Entender convites, recusas, sugestões e como os amigos combinam um plano.
aulas.foco: Would you like...? / Why don't we...? / Shall we...? / Let's...; accepting and refusing
explicacao: Convite: Would you like to come to the cinema? Resposta: Yes, I'd love to. / Sorry, I can't.
Sugestões: Why don't we go tomorrow? / Shall we have pizza? / Let's meet at six. / What about Saturday?
Recusa educada: Thanks, but I can't. I have to study. Depois, a pessoa costuma propor outra opção.
Cuidado: nem toda sugestão é aceita. Ouça quem aceita e quem muda de ideia.

falas.t: Hi Mia, it's Jo. Would you like to come to the cinema tonight?
Thanks, but I can't. I have to study for a test. Why don't we go tomorrow?
Tomorrow I'm playing football. What about Saturday?
Saturday's good. Shall we have pizza first?
I'd prefer Chinese food, to be honest.
OK, let's meet at the restaurant at six. The film starts at half past seven.
Great. Shall I book the table?
Yes, please. For two people.
Perfect. See you on Saturday!
Bye!

exercicios.q: Why can't Mia go to the cinema tonight?
exercicios.exp: I can't. I have to study for a test. O futebol é o motivo do Jo para amanhã.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: ___ you like to come to the cinema tonight?
exercicios.exp: Would you like to...? é o convite mais comum.
exercicios.ouvir: Would you like to come to the cinema tonight?

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Why don't we go tomorrow?
exercicios.exp: Don't we: /dóunt ui/. Entonação cai no final, é uma sugestão.
exercicios.ouvir: Why don't we go tomorrow?

exercicios.q: Why can't they go to the cinema tomorrow?
exercicios.exp: Tomorrow I'm playing football, diz o Jo. O estudo da Mia é hoje à noite.
Shall we + verbo = sugestão em grupo. First = antes.

exercicios.q: Jo prefers ___ food.
exercicios.exp: I'd prefer Chinese food. Ela sugeriu pizza, mas ele prefere comida chinesa.

exercicios.q: Responda ao convite aceitando ou recusando com educação.
exercicios.frase: Would you like to go to the cinema with me on Saturday?
exercicios.modelo: Yes, that's a great idea. What time shall we meet?
exercicios.exp: Aceite: Yes, I'd love to. Recuse: Sorry, I can't. I have to... E sugira outra opção.

exercicios.q: When and where do they meet on Saturday?
op: At half past seven, at the restaurant
At half past seven, at the cinema
exercicios.exp: Let's meet at the restaurant at six. O filme começa às 7h30.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: Shall I ___ the table?
exercicios.exp: Book a table = reservar uma mesa.
exercicios.ouvir: Great. Shall I book the table?

aulas.titulo: Booking a course: forms and messages
aulas.objetivo: Anotar dados de uma inscrição por telefone: dias, datas, preços, nome e número.
aulas.foco: Note-taking: days, times, dates, prices, spelled names, phone numbers
explicacao: Na prova, você completa uma ficha com palavras, números, datas e nomes soletrados. Escreva só o que falta.
Fique atento às correções e aos números parecidos: thirteen/thirty, fifteen/fifty, and nineteen/ninety.
Descontos: ten per cent discount = 10% de desconto. O preço final pode ser dito depois.
Nomes soletrados: ouça letra por letra e confira no final se você formou um nome possível.

falas.t: Welcome to Sunrise Language School. How can I help?
Hello, I'd like to book a course. Do you have English classes in the evening?
Yes. There's a beginners' course on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from half past six to eight. It starts on the third of October and lasts ten weeks.
How much is it?
Two hundred and sixty pounds, but there's a ten per cent discount for students, so it's two hundred and thirty-four pounds for you.
I'm a student. My name is Paula Reynolds. R-E-Y-N-O-L-D-S.
And your phone number?
Oh seven seven eight four, two one nine, six nine two.
Thank you. Please bring a passport photo to the first lesson.

exercicios.q: Which days is the course?
exercicios.exp: A beginners' course on Tuesdays and Thursdays, das 18h30 às 20h.

exercicios.q: Ouça e complete: The course starts on the ___ of October.
exercicios.exp: The third of October = 3 de outubro.
exercicios.ouvir: It starts on the third of October and lasts ten weeks.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: Please bring a passport photo to the first lesson.
exercicios.exp: Photo: /fôutou/. Passport: força em PASS. Lesson: /lésn/.
exercicios.ouvir: Please bring a passport photo to the first lesson.

exercicios.q: How much will Paula pay?
exercicios.exp: O preço é £260, mas estudantes têm 10% de desconto: £234 (two hundred and thirty-four).
Last é verbo aqui: durar. The course lasts = o curso dura.

exercicios.q: O número de Paula: 07784 219 ___
exercicios.exp: Oh seven seven eight four, two one nine, six nine two.

exercicios.q: Diga qual outro idioma você gostaria de estudar e por quê.
exercicios.frase: Would you like to study another language? Which one and why?
exercicios.modelo: Yes, I'd like to study Spanish because it's useful for travelling.
exercicios.exp: Use I'd like to study... because... Ex.: because I want to travel.

exercicios.q: What time do the lessons finish?
exercicios.exp: From half past six to eight: começam às 18h30 e terminam às 20h.

exercicios.q: Ouça as letras e escreva o sobrenome: ___
exercicios.exp: R-E-Y-N-O-L-D-S forma Reynolds.
exercicios.ouvir: R. E. Y. N. O. L. D. S.

aulas.objetivo: Praticar no formato da prova: perguntas de marcar, ficha para completar e ligar pessoas a informações.
aulas.foco: Exam practice: multiple choice, note completion, matching, spelling and numbers
explicacao: Leia as perguntas ANTES de ouvir. Na prova, o áudio toca duas vezes: confira o que anotou na segunda vez.
Os distratores aparecem no áudio: 12 e 14 libras, 8h e 8h15, nomes de pessoas. Só vale a informação final.
Nas lacunas, escreva apenas a palavra ou o número que falta. Confira a grafia (Callum, Friday).
Nomes e números soletrados: anote letra por letra e depois junte.

falas.t: Right, everyone. Now, about Saturday's trip to Brighton. The coach leaves school at a quarter past eight, not eight, so please don't be early.
Mr Hall, how much is it? I think my mum said twelve pounds.
It was twelve pounds, but the museum visit is included now, so it's fourteen pounds. Please bring it on Friday.
What shall we bring for lunch?
Sandwiches and a drink. Don't bring chocolate, because we're going to have ice cream on the beach.
Can I bring my camera?
Of course. The weather is going to be good, so wear a hat and bring sun cream. If it rains, we're going to visit the aquarium instead.
What time do we get back?
At about half past six. Your parents can collect you at the school gate.
My brother is going to collect me. His name is Callum. C-A-L-L-U-M.
Fine. And the school's emergency number is oh one two seven three, five five two, four nine zero.

exercicios.q: What time does the coach leave school on Saturday?
exercicios.exp: The coach leaves school at a quarter past eight, not eight. Half past six é a hora de volta.

exercicios.q: Complete a ficha: Cost of the trip: £___
exercicios.exp: Era twelve pounds, mas agora o museu está incluído: fourteen pounds.
exercicios.ouvir: It was twelve pounds, but the museum visit is included now, so it's fourteen pounds.

exercicios.q: What should the students bring for lunch?
exercicios.exp: Sandwiches and a drink. Chocolate não, porque haverá ice cream na praia.

exercicios.q: Complete a ficha: Bring the money on ___
exercicios.exp: Please bring it on Friday: levar o dinheiro na sexta.

exercicios.q: Ouça o modelo e repita a frase em voz alta.
exercicios.frase: The coach leaves school at a quarter past eight.
exercicios.exp: Quarter past: /kuórter past/. Eight: /êit/.
exercicios.ouvir: The coach leaves school at a quarter past eight.

exercicios.q: What are they going to do if it rains?
exercicios.exp: If it rains, we're going to visit the aquarium instead. A praia é o plano com tempo bom.

exercicios.q: Escreva o nome do irmão da Nina: ___
exercicios.exp: C-A-L-L-U-M forma Callum.
exercicios.ouvir: C. A. L. L. U. M.

exercicios.q: Who is going to take a camera?
exercicios.exp: Nina pergunta: Can I bring my camera? Dan pergunta sobre o almoço e o irmão só vai buscá-la.

exercicios.resp: We are going to have ice cream on the beach.
exercicios.exp: Estrutura de plano: sujeito + be going to + verbo + complemento.

exercicios.q: Complete a ficha: School emergency number: 01273 552 ___
exercicios.exp: Four nine zero = 490.
exercicios.ouvir: The school's emergency number is oh one two seven three, five five two, four nine zero.

exercicios.q: Diga aonde você gostaria de ir em uma excursão de um dia.
exercicios.frase: Where would you like to go for a day trip?
exercicios.modelo: I'd like to go to the beach because I love swimming.
exercicios.exp: Use I'd like to go to... because... Ex.: I'd like to go to the zoo because I like animals.

exercicios.q: What time will the students be back at school?
exercicios.exp: At about half past six. Quarter past eight é a hora da saída do ônibus.
